rules.reason_template: {name} has logged {logged_hours}h against {available_hours}h effective sprint capacity ({utilization:.1f}% utilization).
rules.impact_template: High risk of burnout, quality degradation, and delayed delivery.
rules.action_template: Redistribute high-priority issues from {name} to engineers with lower utilization.
rules.outcome_template: Utilization reduces to below {threshold}%, mitigating burnout and improving quality.

rules.reason_template: {name} has low utilization at {utilization:.1f}% ({logged_hours}h logged of {available_hours}h available).
rules.impact_template: Wasted capacity and lower team throughput.
rules.action_template: Assign additional tasks to {name} or reallocate to support overloaded engineers.
rules.outcome_template: Improve team velocity and throughput by utilizing available capacity.

rules.reason_template: {name} has estimation accuracy of {estimationAccuracy:.1f}%, indicating chronic under/over estimation.
rules.impact_template: Reduces predictability of sprint completion and delivery commitments.
rules.action_template: Conduct estimation review session and implement planning poker for {name}'s team.
rules.outcome_template: Improve sprint planning reliability and delivery predictability.

rules.reason_template: {name} is the only engineer with primary skill: {skill}.
rules.impact_template: If {name} is unavailable, all work requiring {skill} will be completely blocked.
rules.action_template: Cross-train another engineer on {skill}. Consider candidates with {skill} as a secondary skill.
rules.outcome_template: Reduce dependency risk from Critical to Moderate for {skill}.

rules.reason_template: Team {name} has a health score of {healthScore:.1f}/100, indicating systemic issues.
rules.impact_template: Severe risk to sprint delivery, team morale, and retention.
rules.action_template: Escalate to delivery manager for intervention. Review workload distribution and blockers for Team {name}.
rules.outcome_template: Prevent attrition, stabilize delivery, and improve team health above {threshold}.

rules.reason_template: {name} is at high burnout risk with {utilization:.1f}% utilization and {criticalIssues} critical issues.
rules.impact_template: Continued high stress leads to reduced productivity, errors, and potential attrition.
rules.action_template: Immediately reduce workload for {name}. Redistribute critical issues and defer non-urgent tasks.
rules.outcome_template: Reduce burnout risk and stabilize engineer performance.

rules.reason_template: {name} has {blockedTickets} blocked issue(s) impacting sprint progress.
rules.impact_template: Blocked issues delay dependent work and reduce sprint completion rate.
rules.action_template: Investigate and resolve blockers for {name}. Escalate dependency issues.
rules.outcome_template: Unblock issues to restore sprint velocity and delivery predictability.

rules.reason_template: Forecasted demand ({forecast_demand} SP) exceeds available capacity ({forecast_capacity}h) by {forecast_gap}.
rules.impact_template: Sprint commitments are at risk of being unmet. Delivery timeline may slip.
rules.action_template: Reduce sprint scope, redistribute work, or augment team capacity.
rules.outcome_template: Align demand with capacity to ensure reliable delivery.
